top_signals.title: Japan Poised to Ramp Up LNG Buying as Power Prices Surge
top_signals.summary: Japanese utilities may raise spot LNG cargo buying as surging electricity prices in recent days have made gas-fired power generation profitable for the first time since the Iran war began.  Japan’s physical spark spread, the difference between the price received by a power-generating facility for electricity produced, has turned positive on a seven-day average for the first time since the Middle East conflict began, data compiled by Bloomberg showed on Tuesday. top_signals.title: Top Strategist Calls Nvidia a House of Cards
top_signals.summary: Nvidia’s rebound may have bought the AI trade time, but delayed data-center construction, price-sensitive demand and mounting scrutiny are raising doubts about future profits says Matt Maley, Miller Tabak and Co. Chief Market Strategist and The Maley Report Founder. He joined Bloomberg Open Interest to talk about the market’s reliance on a few key players and why circular financing leaves the sector looking like a house of cards. (Source: Bloomberg)
